# Recursion includes each ticket's own documents.
exec ctx context --project project --ticket root.md
! stderr .
cp stdout result.json
jsonresult result.json true
stdout 'leaf requirements'
stdout 'blocker specification'
stdout '"kind":"blocked_by"'
! stdout dependency_cycle

# A cycle warns without changing successful completeness or exit status.
exec ctx context --project project --ticket cycle.md
! stderr .
cp stdout result.json
jsonresult result.json true
stdout 'dependency_cycle'
stdout '"severity":"warning"'

# Missing blocker context preserves discovered tickets and completed traversal.
exit 1 ctx context --project project --ticket missing-document.md
! stderr .
cp stdout result.json
jsonresult result.json false true
stdout 'source_missing'
stdout 'leaf requirements'

# A missing blocker makes traversal incomplete while known branches continue.
exit 1 ctx context --project project --ticket missing-ticket.md
cp stdout result.json
jsonresult result.json false false
stdout 'source_missing'
stdout 'leaf requirements'

# An unresolved blocker reference leaves discovery unfinished.
exit 1 ctx context --project project --ticket unresolved.md
! stderr .
cp stdout result.json
jsonresult result.json false false
stdout 'unresolved_reference'
stdout 'leaf requirements'
